summary: Frontend-only testing of the new Academy Plaza homepage (CampusMapPage with plaza prop). Verified structure, buildings, signs, locked gates, Quest Board modal (open/close/backdrop), navigation to PLAY/LEARN/CREATE streets, JMAtv/Sticker Shack/Dressing Room/For Grown-Ups, bandstand no-nav behavior, / -> /#/home redirect, /#/home-classic old home, and street regression (signs + now-playing). Tested on desktop 1280x800 and phone landscape 844x390. Overall the plaza works as specified. Found one layout/overlap issue on phone landscape and one transient React duplicate-key warning.

ui_bugs.issue: On phone landscape 844x390, the bandstand marquee/logo overlaps the top header. Measured plaza-logo top=46px while header bottom=76px (overlap ~30px). The 'Jelly of the Month Club' marquee at the top of the bandstand is visibly clipped behind the ACADEMY PLAZA header pill. Spec says: 'bandstand marquee/logo must be below the header'.

issues: Bandstand marquee top (plaza-logo) sits above header bottom. Suggest adding top padding for plaza content on short viewports or lowering the bandstand/logo start Y.

console_warnings.issue: Transient React warning observed on first plaza load: 'Encountered two children with the same key'. Did not reproduce on subsequent loads. Likely in an AnimatePresence list (hosts shout, or buildings) — recommend auditing key assignment on PLAZA_BUILDINGS/host shouts for uniqueness.
AnimatePresence with mode='wait' is receiving multiple children warnings (x2).

verification_matrix.plaza_at_/#/home: PASS (data-plaza=true, all 8 buildings present, no campus-sign-left/right)
verification_matrix.locked_learn_create_with_pill_Earn_1_bad: PASS (data-locked=true, pill 'Earn 1 badge', clicks do not navigate)
verification_matrix.quest_board_opens_modal_and_close_via_X_: PASS (modal present, 5 buttons incl. 3 GOs + close)

action_items: Fix bandstand marquee/logo being clipped behind the top header on phone landscape (844x390). plaza-logo top (46px) < header bottom (76px). Add top offset on short viewports or shift bandstand down.
Audit the duplicate-key React warning observed on first plaza mount (likely in Host shout list or AnimatePresence block). Low priority but should be cleaned up.
critical_code_review_comments: CampusMapPage.js is handling both street and plaza modes which is making the file quite complex; consider splitting plaza concerns (hosts/custom bandstand/quests modal) into a Plaza subcomponent for readability.
AnimatePresence mode='wait' with multiple animated children emits warnings — review structure in CampusMapPage swim/entering/shout animations.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Plaza fully functional end-to-end. Only remaining items to re-verify after fixes: (1) bandstand marquee below header on phone 844x390, (2) absence of React duplicate-key warning on initial load of /#/home. Expected 404s for assets/voice/charlie.hub.*.mp3 occurred (not bugs).
